Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to consolidate consistent, authoritative findings and entered a redundant verification loop. After WebSurfer surfaced official government domains indicating Dazhou is in Sichuan (alongside prior confirmation that Dafeng District is in Jiangsu), the Planner still claimed the province was “not yet solidly confirmed” and kept repeating identical search requests. This mismanagement of termination criteria and failure to synthesize results stalled the task instead of concluding that the two places are not in the same province.
